description: Strong match — applicant experience directly mirrors the role

input.applicant: 4 years PM at Practo, shipped an AI symptom checker used by 200k patients per month, led a team of 6 engineers and 2 designers, reduced average triage time by 34%

expected_output: Short message (3–4 sentences) referencing the AI triage angle specifically. Connects applicant's symptom checker work and triage metric directly. Ends with a soft, specific ask like '15 minutes this week?'.

description: Vague JD — no specifics to latch onto

description: Applicant has a referral from a mutual connection
